transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad for a very long time now. It's been going on for about a year and a half, and I just can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event or major life change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?

I'm not really sure if there was a specific trigger or stressful event. These feelings just seemed to develop on their own without any clear cause. It feels like they just slowly crept up on me over time.
Over the past year and a half, have you felt depressed nearly every day the whole time, or were there periods of at least 2 months when you felt mostly okay?

Yes, I have felt depressed nearly every single day for the entire year and five months. I haven't had any periods where I felt okay that lasted for two months or even close to that. It has just been completely constant the whole time.

During this time, have there been periods of at least 2 weeks when, along with feeling depressed, you also had several other symptoms like poor sleep, low energy, appetite changes, trouble concentrating, guilt, or loss of interest?

Yes, I have definitely experienced those. Along with the depressed mood, I've completely lost interest in everything, my appetite has changed, and I feel this constant, heavy guilt and worthlessness. It hasn't just been for two weeks; I've felt this way almost every day for the entire year and five months.
Before this past year and a half, was there an earlier period of at least 2 years when you felt chronically down but not as severely depressed as you do now?

No, I haven't really experienced a long-term period of chronic low mood like that before this current episode started. Before this past year and a half, my mood was generally fine and I didn't have any lasting issues.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to die or of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of wanting to die or hurting myself. Fortunately, those kinds of thoughts have not crossed my mind at all.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, or were more impulsive than usual?

No, I have never experienced anything like that. In fact, I've felt the complete opposite—just constantly down, exhausted, and really low in energy. I've never had periods of feeling euphoric or having high energy.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient describes a single prolonged depressive episode lasting about 1 year and 5 months with depressed mood nearly every day, marked loss of interest, appetite change, guilt/worthlessness, and low energy. There is no history of manic or hypomanic episodes, no prior chronic 2-year depressive baseline to support persistent depressive disorder, and no clear psychosocial trigger suggesting adjustment disorder.
